desc:
This year, we’re marking 10 years of Yaqeen — a decade of turning questions into clarity, doubt into conviction, and scholarship into a source of strength for Muslims around the world. ⁠
⁠
And we’d love for you to join us for Yaqeen’s Annual Toronto Conference as we reflect on this journey and look ahead to what’s next. We look forward to seeing you in Toronto, insha’Allah.⁠
location: 123 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5H 2M9, Canada
title: Yaqeen’s Annual Toronto Conference
